articles.title: fpbinject added to PyPI
articles.summary: FPBInject enables runtime code injection for ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers, allowing function replacement on a running MCU via a serial connection. This innovative method eliminates the need for reflashing, debuggers, or downtime, offering efficient system updates. It utilizes the Flash Patch and Breakpoint (FPB) unit for seamless operation on embedded systems, enhancing flexibility in system maintenance and development.
